cases.name: Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.
UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, that operates an AI music generation platform at suno.com. The company describes its service as capable of producing complete original songs, including vocals, lyrics, and full production, from a single text prompt in under a minute, across any genre. A free tier is available, while paid tiers add volume and features: the Pro plan offers 500 songs per month, commercial use rights, royalty-free music, stem separation, audio uploads of up to 8 minutes, and access to v5.5, which the company describes as its best and most personalized AI music model, while the Premier plan offers 2,000 songs per month along with Suno Studio, a web-based generative audio workstation that combines traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered creation, plus a multitrack editor, MIDI export, and Persona Voices.

Suno faces substantial litigation tied to its AI training and output practices. The major recording industry case, UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc., is pending in the District of Massachusetts, and seven additional suits have been filed across federal courts in Massachusetts, Texas, New York, and Illinois, including cases brought by individual plaintiffs and by S.A. Jamendo. The site's held facts record 93 items of legal exposure coded to Massachusetts, reflecting the concentration of filings there.
